# PixelEditor — Private Browser-Based Photo & Image Studio
> https://pixeleditor.mrmanager.me/

## Entity Identity & Suite Affiliation
- **Parent Organization**: MrManager Suite (https://mrmanager.me)
- **Suite Hub & Official Tool Profile**: https://mrmanager.me/tools/pixeleditor
- **Master Directory**: https://mrmanager.me/tools
- **Master Legal**: Terms (https://mrmanager.me/terms-of-service), Privacy (https://mrmanager.me/privacy-policy)
- **Support & Inquiries**: support@mrmanager.me

## Architectural Overview
PixelEditor is a high-speed, private browser image studio featuring 14 single-purpose tools. It executes 100% client-side via HTML5 Canvas and Web Workers. Zero images, raw pixels, or EXIF metadata are uploaded to remote servers. No account registration, watermarks, or artificial limits.

## The 14 In-Browser Tools
- [Image Resizer](https://pixeleditor.mrmanager.me/image-resizer/): High-fidelity pixel dimension scaling.
- [Image Cropper](https://pixeleditor.mrmanager.me/image-cropper/): Interactive aspect-ratio cropping.
- [Rotate & Flip](https://pixeleditor.mrmanager.me/rotate-flip/): Orientation correction and horizontal/vertical flipping.
- [Image Compressor](https://pixeleditor.mrmanager.me/image-compressor/): File size reduction to target KB.
- [JPG to PNG](https://pixeleditor.mrmanager.me/jpg-to-png/): Format conversion with alpha transparency support.
- [PNG to JPG](https://pixeleditor.mrmanager.me/png-to-jpg/): Web format conversion with white-matte blending.
- [JPG to WebP](https://pixeleditor.mrmanager.me/jpg-to-webp/): Next-generation web format encoding.
- [PNG to WebP](https://pixeleditor.mrmanager.me/png-to-webp/): Transparent lossless/lossy WebP compression.
- [WebP to JPG](https://pixeleditor.mrmanager.me/webp-to-jpg/): Universal JPEG format conversion.
- [EXIF Remover](https://pixeleditor.mrmanager.me/exif-remover/): GPS and camera metadata scrubbing.
- [Dimensions Checker](https://pixeleditor.mrmanager.me/dimensions-checker/): Instant resolution and DPI inspection.
- [Batch Resizer](https://pixeleditor.mrmanager.me/batch-resizer/): Multi-image bulk scaling.
- [Batch Compressor](https://pixeleditor.mrmanager.me/batch-compressor/): Multi-image bulk compression.
- [Batch Converter](https://pixeleditor.mrmanager.me/batch-converter/): Multi-image bulk format transformation.
